objective: Test whether bounded broad-RFF retrieval followed by SAVE+RFF reranking improves a three-backbone continuous shortlist without losing broad-RFF nonlinear candidates.

ancestry.outcome_use: Prior outcomes define only the bounded-retrieval hypothesis and family-safety gate. Every ranking outcome is recomputed on unused seeds.

reference_heads.envelope: Maximum held-out R2 across the four frozen nested-tuned head families.

shared_execution.folds: One four-fold shuffled KFold partition per panel, shared across every candidate and geometry; random_state equals panel seed.
shared_execution.training_only: Geometry transforms, target scaling, and feature/target kernel base bandwidths are fit on training-fold rows only.

kernel_alignment.feature_kernel: Equal arithmetic mixture of Gaussian RBF Gram matrices in the fitted feature geometry.
kernel_alignment.target_kernel: Equal arithmetic mixture of Gaussian RBF Gram matrices on the training-scaled scalar target.
kernel_alignment.base_bandwidth: Median strictly positive pairwise squared distance on training-fold values.

bounded_reranker.rule: Preserve the complete maximum broad-RFF rank group. Admit complete broad-RFF rank groups until at least six candidates are in the retrieval pool. Order the remaining retrieved candidates by SAVE+RFF rank groups, then order candidates outside the pool by SAVE+RFF rank groups.
bounded_reranker.cutoff_ties: A broad-RFF rank group crossing retrieval position six is included in full.
bounded_reranker.rationale: Depth six equals twice the frozen three-backbone shortlist size and is fixed independently of new-seed outcomes.

ranking_methods.unbounded_winner_fill: Complete broad-RFF winner group followed by all remaining candidates in SAVE+RFF order
ranking_methods.bounded6_rerank: Complete broad-RFF winner group followed by SAVE+RFF reranking inside the broad top-six retrieval pool, then the outside pool

ranking_ties.pure_methods: Equal scores form one rank group.
ranking_ties.structured_methods: Tier boundaries are strict; equal SAVE+RFF scores within a tier form one rank group.
ranking_ties.evaluation: Uniformly average all top-k subsets admitted by a rank-group tie at the cutoff.

bootstrap.pairing: All method contrasts preserve the exact panel.

primary: upper95 bounded6_rerank-minus-broad_rff top3 mean utility regret < 0
upper95 bounded6_rerank-minus-save_rff_current top3 mean utility regret < 0
safety: maximum absolute panel top1 regret difference from broad_rff <= 1e-12
maximum family-mean bounded6_rerank-minus-broad_rff top3 mean utility regret <= 0.03
all panel Spearman and material concordance values defined
decision_rule.pass: Every primary and safety criterion must pass.

runtime: Descriptive only. Structured methods are conservatively charged the sum of separately evaluated broad-RFF and SAVE+RFF component wall times.
scope: New-seed synthetic validation of one fixed bounded shortlist rule. A pass permits shared-computation and real-panel validation only; it does not authorize public integration.
